package.description: Secure kiosk lockdown software for Windows.

en-US.description: Secure kiosk lockdown software for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: Netkiosk EdgeKiosk Basic is an easy to use PC lockdown and secure kiosk browser solution for small businesses. Built on Microsoft WebView2, it runs a secure full-screen kiosk browser, blocks access to the desktop, taskbar and settings, and supports website whitelists, an idle time reset timer, automatic restart protection and full admin configuration.
en-US.name: Netkiosk EdgeKiosk Basic

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Windows 的安全上网亭锁定软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: Netkiosk EdgeKiosk Basic 是一款易于使用的 PC 锁定和安全上网亭浏览器解决方案，适合小型企业使用。它基于 Microsoft WebView2 构建安全的全屏上网亭浏览器，可阻止访问桌面、任务栏和系统设置，支持网站白名单、空闲时间自动重置、自动重启保护，并提供完整的管理员配置功能。
